categories.bottleneck: Two finite walls and a gap; mandatory C-space passage not established
categories.dense_clutter: Random spheres, different size distribution from sparse_clutter
categories.open_control: No added obstacles; fixed table/equipment and robot self collision remain
categories.route_choice: Two sphere clusters; C-space homotopy classes not established
categories.sparse_clutter: Mixed boxes and spheres; not a density-only control against dense_clutter

generation.open_control: All open_control IDs share one base-only physical environment across splits
generation.planner_seed: Run-level paired method_seed; never a new scene or query
generation.query_seed: Original endpoint_seed; independent domain from scene_seed
generation.selection_policy: Geometry validity and endpoint validity/distance bins only; no algorithm-success selection

geometry.planner_padding: Planner-specific conservative search margins recorded in evaluation config; common validation geometry does not change
geometry.representation: Union of frozen float32-centred obstacle spheres; conservative cover of source primitives
geometry.source_primitive_inflation: Nonuniform conservative cover; see each scene voxelization certificate, not a uniform radius expansion

index_semantics: Reference view of existing frozen inputs; no resampling, no best-of selection, no planner-success task filtering
known_data_issues: 27 original generation failures remain registered; legal planner failures are not input failures
dev short/medium/long ratio is 1:1:1, legal test is 2:2:1
Several problem IDs share one scene; use environment_cluster for correlated statistics
The test split has historical evaluation exposure and is not an untouched holdout; tuning provenance must accompany new comparisons
Conservative voxel cover can appreciably alter source primitive clearance

model.filter_policy: Unmodified CSD finalize_scene: exclude world-world, same link, adjacent links and fixed-connected links. Exactly equal to native Drake candidates for this model.
model.fixed_environment: Table, two camera/tripod assemblies and protective box in the canonical directive
model.gripper: Robotiq 2F85 welded finger URDF; no additional active gripper joints
model.independent_checker: Drake signed primitive distances and Drake forward poses; analytic double precision sphere-to-box signed distance for online voxels
model.joint_metric: Euclidean L2 in bounded R7, radians; no angular wrapping or endpoint normalization
model.world_frame: right-handed world; coordinates and distances in metres

motion_limits.endpoint_acceleration: Not constrained to zero; same bounded acceleration limits apply
motion_limits.time_continuity: C1 with numerical tolerance; Bezier/B-spline derivative control hull bounds

witnesses.policy: First lexicographic receipt-bound validated artifact establishes existence only; no best-of metric selection; solver success alone rejected
